(1)  There  shall  be  a  Dispute  Resolution  Panel

column1: (hereinafter  referred  to  as  “the  Panel”)  for  the  purpose  of
resolution of disputes on interim order. The Panel shall consist
of a Chairman and four members and a Secretary appointed
by the Commissioner-General. Every member of the Panel
so appointed shall hold office for a term not exceeding two
years, but shall be eligible for reappointment.
